name: Bellevue Cubing for Children's 2022
information:
This is a fundraiser competition. Please visit the fundraiser tab for more information. 

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BellevueCubingforChildrens2022#20223-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please also be sure to review the [Health and Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BellevueCubingforChildrens2022#20224-health-and-safety) tab to check our COVID-19 requirements for this competition.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!

3x3x3 Finals will be Head to Head at this competition.
